attributes.title: 63rd Annual Conference & Alumni Weekend
attributes.series: UGA College of Veterinary Medicine Annual Conference & Alumni Weekend
attributes.venue: UGA Center for Continuing Education and Hotel
attributes.organizer: University of Georgia College of Veterinary Medicine
attributes.summary:
The University of Georgia College of Veterinary Medicine holds its 63rd Annual Conference & Alumni Weekend March 19 and 20, 2027 at the UGA Center for Continuing Education and Hotel in Athens, Georgia. The weekend combines continuing education for veterinarians with class reunions and college events.

Registration opens in early December 2026. The group hotel rate covers March 18 to 21 and must be booked by February 16, 2027.

The event page does not list the fees, CE hours or RACE approval yet. Graduates are asked to update their contact details with the college so they receive the program.
